// Classifier fixture, vitest: TAUTOLOGY-ONLY and its negatives. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

describe("tautology", () => {
  it("handles alerts", () => {
    recordAlert("warning");
    expect(true).toBeTruthy();
    expect({ level: "warning" }).toEqual({ level: "warning" });
  });

  it("counts retried events", async () => {
    const retriedCount = await handler.retryFailedEvents();
    expect(retriedCount >= 0).toBeTruthy();
    expect(handler.queue.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
  });

  it("retries one event", async () => {
    const retriedCount = await handler.retryFailedEvents();
    expect(retriedCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it("keeps at least one event queued", () => {
    expect(handler.queue.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});
